The figure presents a bar chart illustrating the negative log probability of per-specialty terms for various fine-tuned models compared to a base model. The chart's horizontal axis represents different medical specialties, including Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics, while the vertical axis represents the negative log probability, ranging from -27 to -22, with a linear scale and labeled tick marks. Each specialty on the horizontal axis corresponds to a group of bars representing different fine-tuned models, distinguished by colors: Cardio (light blue), Gastro (light orange), Infect (orange), Neuro (brown), Obstetrics (dark brown), and Pediatrics (darkest brown), along with a light blue bar for the Mistralv0.2-Base model for reference. The bars within each group exhibit varying heights, indicating differences in negative log probability values; for instance, the Mistralv0.2-Base model shows approximate values ranging from -26 to -22 across specialties, whereas the fine-tuned models display a range of values, with some bars reaching as high as -22 and others as low as -26.5. The bars are not sorted in a specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color-coded representation. The chart effectively visualizes the comparison of negative log probabilities across different specialties and models, providing a clear and organized representation of the data.
